picks.why: Fills the frame like the real cards, has clean stone blocks and a plain wooden door. Candidate 1 adds iron bands and 3 adds spike finials.
Believable book thickness and a clean page block, angled like the real book. Candidate 1's spine is swollen and 3's back cover overhangs oddly.
The tilted bottle matches the real card's lively pose, with a slim true neck and restrained liquid. Candidates 1 and 3 sit stiffer and more upright.
Reads instantly as a skull, with a well-proportioned jaw and comfortable framing. Candidate 3 adds speckle marks and 1 is oversized and crowded in the frame.
Only candidate. It has clear bat anatomy and a clean silhouette with no extras.
Large in the frame like the real cards, with a clean web and only a tiny droplet. Candidate 3 invents wrapped silk knots and 2 sits smaller with a more prominent drop.
Long, true vehicle proportions with restrained trim, reading as a hearse. Candidate 2 is chunkier and toy-like, with excess gold and extra lamps.
Classic triangle-eyed plastic pumpkin pail that reads instantly. Its face is simple, where 2 and 3 add cuter, more stylised smiling eyes.
Clear dead-tree silhouette with a simple trunk and restrained wood detail. Candidate 1 has an overly wide root flare and 3's bark and branches are busier.
Crisp three-quarter box form with a true half-barrel lid, close to the real card's angle. Candidate 2 is soft and toy-like with a shield-shaped lock, and 3 is flatter.
